card.name: Words just before university or campus names
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation in academic web text that come right before a university, college, or campus name or term, such as 'across', 'on and off', or a comma before the school.

modes.label: Linking word before a school
modes.description: A preposition or article just before a named university or college.
modes.example: students<< across>> Harvard who share an interest in

modes.label: Comma or punctuation in affiliations
modes.description: A comma or space after a department or museum name, before the university name.
modes.example: Georgia Museum of Natural History<<,>> University of Georgia

modes.label: Campus or program context
modes.description: Words in education settings where campus or program is expected next.
modes.example: informal settings both on and<< off>> campus, through meals

card.writes: It pushes toward campus and witness-type words and away from medicine words, which fits a university setting rather than a medical one.
card.plain: It fires on small words in university text that come right before a school or campus name.
